name: 02920 · Cranston, RI
findings: ZIP 02920 (Cranston) has 159 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02920 (Cranston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02920 (Cranston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
